test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

The orator declared that the women are ________ than the men.
solution:
The correct answer is '**more intelligent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**more intelligent**" is used to compare two entities, in this case, women and men.
 
• Option 2 "**intelligenter**" is incorrect because it is not a valid comparative form.
 
• Option 1 "**most intelligent**" is incorrect because it is the superlative form and is used for comparisons involving three or more entities.
 
• Option 4 "**inteligent**" is incorrect as it is a misspelling of "intelligent."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The orator declared that the women are **more intelligent**__ than the men."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "most intelligent"** is a superlative form used when comparing more than two entities.
 
• **Option 2: "intelligenter"** is not a valid word in English grammar.
 
• **Option 4: "inteligent"** is a misspelling and grammatically incorrect.
